column3: NASB renders the dimensions with “in length” and “depth.”
“Windows of frames shut” is rendered “windows with artistic frames”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Perfect stone of quarry” is rendered “stone prepared at the quarry.”
The Hebrew reads “the middle side chamber”; NASB has “the lowest,” as in some ancient versions. “South side” is rendered “right side,” and “stairs” as “winding stairs.”
“He covered the house with cedar wood” is rendered “they were fastened to the house with timbers of cedar.”
“Establish” is rendered “carry out,” and NASB supplies “Concerning.”
“Walls of the ceiling” is rendered “the ceiling.”
“The walls” is rendered “the ceiling,” and “the holy of holies” as “the most holy place.”
“The temple before me” is rendered “the nave in front of the inner sanctuary”; the Hebrew is difficult.
“From faces and to the outer” is rendered “inner and outer sanctuaries”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Within and outer” is rendered “inner and outer sanctuaries.”
